verdicts.reason: Both break the brand header the same way: the dark band is cut down to a stray block in the top-right corner, and the white SOLSTICE wordmark now sits on cream, where it can't be seen. In A the body copy is set nearly as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy, and the orange divider rule runs into the word "and"; B keeps the body copy subordinate and avoids that collision. However, B's rule floats alone off to the right, its body and legal text are very small at this size, and its CTA is tiny.
